title: Three lenses for modernization planning
lens_1_definition: Architecture, data, integration, and lifecycle constraints that shape viable target-state options.
lens_1_benefit: Reveal dependencies and risks before selecting a modernization pattern.
lens_3_definition: Business outcomes, baseline measures, pilot scope, and evidence needed to compare options.
lens_2_benefit: Clarify who will decide, operate, and support each service.
recommendation: RECOMMENDATION: Validate technical feasibility, ownership, and baseline value before sequencing the first wave.
lens_2_definition: Decision rights, service ownership, skills, and support arrangements needed for transition.
lens_3_benefit_detail: Test value hypotheses against a credible baseline and feasible pilot.
